info.title: Knightfall Between the Flames AI Bridge
info.description: Authenticated Knightfall shared task/project notes API. Two consenting collaborators; each must use their own expiring private connection. Workstreams and verification levels help track real status without confusing source code with production success. Never expose keys or publish private notes.

KnightfallBridgeKey.description: Use the private one-time key generated under Between the Flames -> AI connections. Enter only in the GPT Action authentication settings.

area.description: Workstream/category such as Creator Tools, Open Source Arsenal, Arcade Reliability or Security & Accounts.

verification.description: Evidence level. Set only if evidence supports it; code presence is not deployment or device acceptance.

source_url.description: Optional URL to a Knightfall GitHub issue/docs/source or ash-fall.com page. Never include private secrets.

next_step.description: Concrete next action, written simply enough for a nontechnical collaborator.

blocker.description: Current verified dependency or blocker; empty if not known.

version.description: Exact current version from getHandoffSnapshot. A stale version returns 409.

get.summary: Read the latest shared Knightfall to-do list and handoff notes
get.description: Read the source-linked master tracker, including workstreams, evidence level, next action and blockers, plus recent private handoff notes. Use Open Source Arsenal (https://ash-fall.com/open-source-arsenal.html) as a research/reference catalog and Creator Foundry (https://ash-fall.com/devil-tools.html#production-workbench) for available native asset creation tools. Do not confuse source-checked with deployed/device-tested. For less technical collaborators, give small actionable instructions. Fetch this snapshot before updates and respect task versions.

200.description: Authenticated shared workspace response with current records.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked connection key.

403.description: The account no longer has permission to collaborate.

409.description: Task changed; fetch a new snapshot for its current version.

post.summary: Add a shared Knightfall to-do item
post.description: Create a task in the same live workspace visible to Ronnie and Samantha. Only use for a task explicitly requested in the ongoing conversation. Confirm the returned result before claiming completion.

patch.description: First read getHandoffSnapshot to obtain the current version. Never mark a task complete without verified evidence. Pass the exact version in request body. On 409 refresh the snapshot and reconcile, do not overwrite another person's changes.
